VeriHarness (arXiv 2610.00972).takeaway: long-horizon agent learning is a verification bottleneck; evolving VERIFIER skills yields +6.2/+6.4 pts over a single rollout; ~26k rollouts released

Who Verifies the Verifier (arXiv 2610.11.takeaway: removing anchor guards produces an always-pass grader that trains skills JUST AS WELL; downstream task score cannot certify a self-evolved verifier; industry anchors = hand-written rubrics / human record-once

The Measurability Gap (arXiv 2602.20946).takeaway: execution scales exponentially while verification bandwidth caps realized value - verification is the structural bottleneck of agent work

Learning by Doing (arXiv 2611.01386).takeaway: skills compiled from VERIFIED teacher traces: +4.5..+18.8 (tau^3/AppWorld/EnterpriseOps), ALFWorld +32.6 from a weak base with no training - but gain exists ONLY on tasks the teacher solved (failed: +0.6 ~= 0) and no gain on new tasks: external refutation of once-solves-everything

GitHub agent-skills study (arXiv 2611.04.takeaway: 28.9% of real agent skills on GitHub lack trigger conditions - the phrase-gate defect is real in the wild

Progressive Skill Generation RL (arXiv 2.takeaway: one-shot skill generation loses to progressive generation (+14.0 SpreadsheetBench, +10.8 tau^2)

SkillRevise (arXiv 2606.01139).takeaway: one-shot skills are syntactically well formed yet behaviorally weak; execution-grounded revision + verifier-first selection: 36.05 -> 61.63%

CoEvoSkills/EvoSkills (arXiv 2604.01687).takeaway: surrogate-verifier ablation costs ~30 pp - dense verifier feedback is the lever in skill evolution

Trace2Skill (arXiv 2605.21810).takeaway: dense verifier feedback + skill evolution with NO weight updates: 0/8 -> 6/8 hard tasks, beating Claude Code and Codex

VASO (arXiv 2606.05395).takeaway: skills as formal, model-checked contracts; trace evidence != temporal safety; 97.2% compliance

Skill-selection scaling (arXiv 2601.0474.takeaway: skill libraries hit a capacity threshold; semantic confusability drives degradation - bigger libraries do not scale

SkillComposer (arXiv 2606.05066).takeaway: intra-task composition success collapses when composed across tasks; existing harnesses cannot verify composed skills

Skill-V (arXiv 2610.11781).takeaway: skills as versioned falsifiable contracts with preconditions/postconditions and an applicability filter - the field converges on checkable contracts, maintained not grown

CompoSkill (arXiv 2608.16246).takeaway: individually scanner-passing skills still compose into harmful paths - per-item verification is not composition verification

SkillCommit (arXiv 2608.15165).takeaway: scope overreach is the main cause of negative transfer; gate every abstraction by replay of every source instance

Agent memory survey (arXiv 2603.07670).takeaway: parametric memory is hard to audit, delete, and update; deployed agents favor non-parametric inspectable stores - knowledge outside weights is the field's default

Knowledge Access Beats Model Size (arXiv.takeaway: 8B + memory = 30.5% F1 vs 235B without memory = 13.7% F1; knowledge access, not parameter count, determines quality on personalization - memory > model size

When Continual Learning Moves to Memory.takeaway: external memory relocates the continual-learning bottleneck from parameter updates to retrieval - ungated permanence is not permanence (the tree measured the same at 53.5% stale replay)

Hierarchical Memory Tree (arXiv 2603.070.takeaway: raw element identifiers fail cross-website; stages stored with pre/post-conditions and semantic descriptors transfer - corroborates index-by-property over index-by-name

World-Model Action Correction (arXiv 260.takeaway: candidate actions are proposed then simulated/graded before execution - proposal + pre-execution verdict, the same loop shape the tree measured

is_it_revolutionary.because: The one-shot form is refuted everywhere (0/200 here; one-shot skill generation loses repeatedly: 2608.01678, 2606.01139, 2606.11435; Learning-by-Doing gains exist only where a teacher already solved). The loop form - observation -> anchored verdict -> gated permanence -> effect-checked composition, knowledge outside weights - is what the Nov-2026 frontier is converging on, and this tree has it measured end to end where others have fragments.
